name: web-community-calendar-tool-long-landing-page
title: Very long landing page for a calendar-sharing tool with paired desktop and mobile screens
whatItIs: A tall board of a white landing page with blue accents: hero, problem section, comparison of two approaches, setup steps, Google integration diagrams, member experience with a photo, feature grid, competitor comparison and audience photos, ending with a call to action. Phone versions are staggered to the side.
whatItMeans: Organised and thorough; the long flow answers each objection in order.
techniques: Structure the page as a sequence of objections: problem, solution, setup, integration, proof, audience, action.
Show diagrams of integrations with logos linked by dashed lines.
Repeat the same layout on mobile next to desktop.
bestFor: Products built on top of a familiar platform

vocabulary.definition: Ordering sections to answer visitor doubts in turn.
A split block contrasting two approaches.
A picture linking a product to the tools it works with.
A single-page layout with many stacked sections.
